title: React function has high control-flow complexity
message: `PlannerShiftScheduler` has cyclomatic complexity 19, cognitive complexity 17, and maximum nesting depth 1, so its React logic is hard to understand and change. Extract independent branches into components or hooks.
help: Extract independent render branches and state logic into focused components or hooks until the control flow is easy to follow.

title: Large component is hard to read and change
message: Component "PlannerShiftScheduler" is over 300 lines long, which is hard to read & change. Split it into a few smaller components.
help: Pull each section into its own component so the parent is easier to read, test, and change.
